paite: Huchi in huai tengteng ahih khit un huai a Israel mi om tengteng in Judah gam tengteng leh Benjamin gam leh Ephraim leh Manasseh gam suangphuhte ahihzan ua, Asherahte aphuk ua, mun sangte leh maitamte achipsak vek masiah uh Judah gam khuate ah apai zel uhi. Huchi in Israel suante tengteng agam uah amau khua chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
heading: Hezekiah In Sabiak Hinkhua Abawl Thak
english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in siampute leh Levite apawldan bang zel un michih siampute leh Levite'n atuah chiat ding un, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat lanmi dingte, nasemmi dingte, kipahthu genmi ding leh TOUPA omna kongpi a ngakmi dingte pawl abawlsak chiat hi.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.

paite: TOUPA dan a tuang bangbang in zingsang lam leh nitaklam halmang thillat dingte, Sabbath leh kha thak leh hunbi nei ankuang a dingte kumpipa tantuan a ding asep hi.
english: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in Yahweh’s law.

paite: Jerusalem a mipite TOUPA dan a akihihhatna ding un siampute leh Levite tantuan pe ding in thu ape lai hi.
english: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to Yahweh’s law.

paite: Huai thupiak adalhzaktak in Israel suante'n abuhte, uainte, thaute, khuaizute, alou ua thilsuak masapente ahong pia ua; abangkim uh sawm-a-khat leng ahong pia uhi.
english: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.

paite: srael suante leh Judah suante, Judah khuate a omte'n abawng uleh belam uh sawm-a-khatte, TOUPA a Pathian uh tantuam dia apiaksawn uh sawm-a-khatte ahon pia ua, akoihkhawm ekok phet uhi.
english: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to Yahweh their God, and laid them in heaps.

paite: Kha thumna ah akoihkhawm pan ua, akha sagihna ah akoihkhawm khin uhi.
english: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah leh amiliante un koihkhawm amuh un TOUPA leh ami Israelte aphat uhi.
english: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.

paite: Hezekiah in athil koihkhawm tungtang thu uh huai siampute leh Levite adong a.
english: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

paite: Zadok mi siampu heutu Azariah in adawng a, "Mite'n TOUPA' inn a thilpiak ahon tawi tung ua kipan in i ne zel ua, i deihkhop ua, a-om ekok lai hi. TOUPA'N mite avualzawl zel a, hiai a om ekok lai teng i kham val uh ei ve," achi hi.
english: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn ah dantante bawl ding in thu apia a; abawlta uhi.
english: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh’s house, and they prepared them.

paite: Huan thilpiakte sawm-a-khatte, Pathian a tuamte muanhuaitak in anawn lut uhi: aheutu uh Levi mi Konaniah ahi a, a-unau Shimei bel azom ahi.
english: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

paite: Konaniah leh a-unau Shimei nuai ah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Pathian inn a heutu Azariah seh in endikmi Jehiel, Azajiah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath leh Benaiahte a-om uhi.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

paite: Levi mi Imna tapa Kore, suahlam kongkhak ngakmi Pathian kiang a lungsim ut thu a thilpiak kempa leh TOUPA a dia thilpiak leh thil siangthoupen hawmpa ahi.
english: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute Yahweh’s offerings and the most holy things.

paite: Anuai ah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, Shekaniah, siampu khua ah nasep hunbi chiat ah a-unaute uh apawlpawl aneu leh aliante kiang a semmi a-om uhi:
english: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

paite: Khangthu sut pasal kum thum chiang tunglam, niteng a TOUPA' inn a nasep kul nei a pawl dandan bang ua hohsekte sim louh in.
english: in addition to those who were listed by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into Yahweh’s house, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;

paite: A-inkuan uh pipute gelhna a siampu asehte leh Levi mi kum sawmnih chiang tunglam apawldan bang zel ua nasemmi dia sehte;
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’ houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;

paite: pipute gelhna a tuang ataneute tengteng uh, azite uh, atapate uh, a-inkuan tengteng uh; asepna bik ua siangthoutak a akihihsiangthoute ahi uhi.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

paite: Aaron suan kho chih khopua a om siampute leh Levite suante gelhna a tuang peuhmahte tantuan pe ding mi sehtuam a-om uhi.
english: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

paite: Huchibang in Judah gam tengteng ah Hezekiah in ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in hoih leh dik leh muanhuai thil ahih sek hi.
english: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.

paite: Pathian nasep lam thu ah, dan lam thu ah, thupiak lam thu ah, a Pathian zon thu ah ahih peuhmah ah alungsim tengteng in ahih a, alamzang zel hi.
english: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.
